title: Ma Rainey, Bessie Smith and other blues singers
summary: Armstrong compares Ma Rainey and Bessie Smith and says he played with all of the blues singers.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Did Bessie come from R. Rainey? Is that where she came from as a singer?
Well, I don't know who was first. R. Rainey had been singing a long time. Became a set gal, you know. Good woman. Yeah, I think Bessie came a little later and out sang them all.
Chippy Hill, I was played with them. I played with them all. Sippy Wallace. Sippy Wallace, yeah.
